disaster_name: Annamayya Dam Failure & Cheyyeru Flash Flood (19 November 2021)
region: Rajampet and Nandalur Mandals, Annamayya District (formerly Kadapa), Andhra Pradesh, India

evidence_standards.OBSERVED: Direct sensor, gauge, or physical survey measurement
evidence_standards.OFFICIAL_ESTIMATE: Documented in government situation report or official committee memo
evidence_standards.MODEL_RECONSTRUCTION: Derived from validated hydrologic or hydraulic engineering formulations
evidence_standards.ASSUMED: Engineering scenario parameter bounded by uncertainty intervals

spillway_operating_discharge_m3s.source: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) National Situation Report D692

breach_time_ist.source: District Collectorate Records / MHA Report D692
breach_time_ist.usage: Retained for the underlying three sourced candidate times; superseded as T=0 by event_clock.origin_iso below, which resolves the three by using the MHA point value for the washout/dam-break-origin event specifically (see 2026-09-11 event-clock decision).

eroded_embankment_length_m.source: AP Irrigation Restoration DPR dt 30-10-2022 (EE Kadapa)
eroded_embankment_length_m.usage: Structural bound on breach erosion, NOT instantaneous width

event_clock._decision_record: 2026-09-11: T=0 resolved by the user as the dam failure/washout event (EVD-17), using the MHA D692 point value 06:30 IST, NOT the earlier overtopping-initiation window (EVD-16, ~05:30-06:00) previously hardcoded in src/scenarios.py as 05:45. The 06:15-06:30 EVD-17 range is retained as the failure event's own uncertainty band. Overtopping initiation is kept as its own separate, earlier timeline event rather than being collapsed into T=0. Pincha's sourced 'T-150 min' label in EVD-04/pincha_failure_time is INVALID under this anchor (03:30 to 06:30 is -180 min, not -150) and must not be used for arithmetic; it was computed against the old 05:45-ish anchor family and is superseded by the recomputed t_s values below, derived directly from each event's own historical clock time.
event_clock.origin_label: Annamayya Dam full washout/collapse (MHA-reported point time)
event_clock.uncertainty_note: EVD-17 states a 06:15-06:30 window for full washout; the MHA point value (06:30, the late edge) is used as origin_iso, with the 15-minute window before it carried as uncertainty_s.

timeline_events.label: Annamayya overtopping initiation (water first exceeds +206.0 m crest)
timeline_events.note: Midpoint of the sourced range used as the point t_s; the full range is carried in t_uncertainty_s (900 s = 15 min each side of the midpoint).

timeline_events.label: Cheyyeru gorge exit — arrival of pre-washout overtopping discharge
timeline_events.source: Field witness reports / Local police log (EVD-21)
timeline_events.note: This arrival precedes the T=0 washout event. It is the overtopping-phase discharge (crest flow before the embankment fully eroded away), a physically distinct and earlier pulse than the post-washout breach wave that reaches the same reach afterward — not measurement error. See event_clock._decision_record.

timeline_events.label: Togurupeta hit — pre-washout overtopping discharge
timeline_events.source: AP Disaster Management / Media Surveys, Indian Express Nov 2021 (EVD-22)
timeline_events.note: Same pre-washout overtopping-flow interpretation as gorge_exit_overtopping_flow.

timeline_events.label: Mandapalli hit — breach-wave arrival
timeline_events.source: Eye-witness logs / Paleswara Swamy Temple survey (EVD-23)
timeline_events.note: Range straddles T=0; recorded as a point at the T=0 edge of its own window since the wave is expected to arrive at or shortly after washout, not before.

timeline_events.label: Pulapathur hit — breach-wave arrival, >30 fatalities
timeline_events.source: AP Govt Disaster Management Summary / Casualty Register Kadapa (EVD-24)

timeline_events.label: Gundlur inundation
timeline_events.source: Village Administrative Officer Log / Revenue Department Records (EVD-25)

timeline_events.label: Nandalur arrival & bridge washout
timeline_events.source: South Central Railway Emergency Bulletin / Track Washout Log (EVD-26)

timeline_events.label: Downstream corridor reach, Lebaka to Penagaluru (Pennar confluence)
